objects.name: Analytic 2116
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to Industrial Control System (ICS) project file paths on a Linux engineering station from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with the ICS engineering tool, or from the tool after loading a file from a removable media or network path not in the approved software distribution list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: write to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) project file path by uid not in authorized engineering User Identifiers (UIDs) or from path not in approved project sources
